package repository

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
)

type DialogRequestContextReader interface {
	GetTeacherRequestContext(ctx context.Context, request domain.DialogTeacherRequest, before int) (domain.DialogRequestContext, error)
}

type DialogTeacherResponseAppender interface {
	AppendTeacherResponse(ctx context.Context, request domain.DialogTeacherRequest, idempotencyKey, body string) (domain.DialogMessage, error)
}

// DialogTeacherCoordinatedResponseAppender preserves the legacy append shape
// while allowing S5's registry-built assistant_ui to travel atomically with
// the response body. It is never a browser-facing metadata channel.
type DialogTeacherCoordinatedResponseAppender interface {
	AppendTeacherCoordinatedResponse(ctx context.Context, request domain.DialogTeacherRequest, idempotencyKey string, response domain.TeacherCoordinatedDialogResponse) (domain.DialogMessage, error)
}

type DialogTeacherProactiveAppender interface {
	AppendTeacherProactive(ctx context.Context, binding domain.TeacherDialogBinding, idempotencyKey, body string) (domain.DialogMessage, error)
}

type DialogCanonicalStudentTurnMaterializer interface {
	MaterializeCanonicalStudentTurn(context.Context, domain.CanonicalStudentTurnMaterialization) (domain.DialogMessage, error)
}

type DialogStudentChannelAppender interface {
	AppendStudentChannelMessage(ctx context.Context, binding domain.TeacherDialogBinding, idempotencyKey string, channel domain.DialogMessageChannel, body string) (domain.DialogMessage, error)
}

type TeacherDialogProvisioner interface {
	EnsureTeacherDialog(
		ctx context.Context,
		studentID string,
		personalTeacherID string,
		contextType domain.LearningContextType,
		contextID string,
	) (domain.TeacherDialogBinding, error)
}

type CourseLessonContextReader interface {
	GetLessonContext(ctx context.Context, lessonID, language string) (domain.CourseLessonContent, error)
}

// StudentAssignedLessonContextReader resolves one exact owner/path/item frozen
// projection; it never substitutes mutable Course content.
type StudentAssignedLessonContextReader interface {
	GetAssignedLessonContext(ctx context.Context, studentID, pathID, itemID string) (domain.AssignedLessonContext, error)
}
